result: The team agreed on a fish facing left, and the work was split four ways. Leo took the top of the body, Maya the bottom and the start, Tom the upper tail fin, and Priya the lower tail fin. Leo's top arc came down, but its right end looked pale, so he closed that gap himself. Maya's bottom arc still looked pale where it left the stub, and Tom's bridge and stray-piece fixes addressed it. Priya closed the back edges at the notch in the tail. Near the end, the team agreed: "Hands off, everyone." When the start domino was pushed, the whole fish fell: 112 of 112. Blind judges guessed a fish with a forked tail and a fishing line.
